authors: Marcel R M van den Brink
hook: Gut microbiome diversity at engraftment did not predict non-relapse death after stem cell transplant.
hook_turn: did not predict non-relapse death after stem cell transplant.
summary: In 304 transplant recipients with 2575 stool samples, microbiome diversity at engraftment was unrelated to non-relapse mortality, missing the primary endpoint. Lower baseline diversity did go with shorter survival, and post-transplant cyclophosphamide lowered diversity versus tacrolimus and methotrexate in exploratory analyses. Those secondary findings are associations, not shown causes.
title: Effect of two common GVHD prophylaxis regimens on the gut microbiome in a randomized phase 3 trial.
